description: Zones bleues à Saint-Maur-des-Fossés is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Christian Quest. Extended blue zones on the city of Saint-Maur des Fossés at the end of 2018. Data updated on OpenStreetMap, based on a city map of November 16, 2018 and extracted using overpass-turbo Map of November 2018. Coverage: Christian Quest. The portal shows the English title as "Blue zones in Saint-Maur-des-Fossés" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Christian Quest. Its keywords include stationnement, zones-bleues. The listing shows 2 download or service links in JPG, GEOJSON. The listing shows 2018-11-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
